full_judgment: 31. Therefore, the respondent's contention that he acquired a vested right to the post of IPO by virtue of his acting in that capacity for about five years and enjoying all the emoluments and other benefits, must fail. The appeal is allowed. The judgment and decree of the trial Court are restored. No costs.
